name: Print a Pedestal (Codeforces logo?)
justification: Multiple valid outputs (print any) require a special judge the token checker can't express.
solution_sketch: Minimize h1: h1=ceil(n/3) rounded up until h2,h3 fit; distribute rest as h2=min(n-h1-1, h1-1), h3=n-h1-h2, fix h3>0. Any valid triple accepted.
